def: Meta Superintelligence Labs' model family, launched in April 2026 with Muse Spark, a natively multimodal reasoning model.
practice: As of November 2026 Muse Spark powers meta.ai and the Meta AI app, and Muse Spark Open (October 2026) releases weights (816B total, 42B active parameters, 1M-token context) under the Muse Model License with limited commercial terms.
